result:
I haven't found the site yet, because the soak that would name it can't run until PR #381 is merged. The dispatcher's workers read their logcat filter from master's copy of the scripts (`dispatcher.sh:65`), so a soak queued now would drop `hakuX-stall` again. I've posted a `waiting:` comment on the PR and stopped. What's done:

**1. Logcat filter fix (PR #381, ready for review, CI green, preflight passes).** `docs/testing/dispatcher.sh` now keeps five perflog-only tags it used to drop: `hakuX-stall`, `hakuX-rpbrk`, `hakuX-cpu`, `xemu-gpu` and `xemu-sfp`. `hakuX-pace` was already added by lane.titlerun. The dispatcher's own selftest checks passed locally (198 ok, 0 failures before my 580 s timeout cut the run short); the full selftest ran in CI and passed.

**2. Which sites can fire, read from the code.** #372 counted seven surface-download sites, but only four are live in this build. The others are inside the disabled `#else` branch of `OPT_SURF_TO_TEX_INLINE` or in the debug dumper, and `SURFACE_DOWN_FLUSH` has no caller at all. Each live site has its own counter on the `hakuX-stall` line:

| counter | site | when it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `dl` | `surface.c:1511` | every synchronous download |
| `cDef` | `surface.c:957` | downloads recorded earlier in the frame are needed now |
| `pDl` | `surface.c:1762` | the display asks for a surface (not expected: the Thor presents through AHB) |
| `dDl` | `surface.c:1846` | guest-wide flush (savevm, scale change) |

So the four counters must add up to the finish total on every line. If they don't, there is a fifth site and the split is void.

**3. What the earlier perflog already shows (run `1790409543-blinx372-195142`, no new run).** In the demo, 22 of 29 sampled frames have exactly two surface-download finishes (`Sd2`). Those are exactly the frames with 6-7 surface-to-texture binds. The other 7 frames have one bind and no download finish. It's never 1 or 3, which suggests a fixed pair of downloads tied to render-to-texture rather than a spread across sites.

**4. Registered before any soak (in `docs/lanes/blinx372b/NOTES.md` @ b9ff74c).** It holds the brief's test (does one counter carry at least 80% of the finishes?) and my guess, stated so it can be wrong: `dl`, from `texture.c:1842`. That's a texture sitting at a render target's address with a shape that can't be bound directly. The target gets downloaded to guest memory and uploaded again. The main alternative is a blit. There's no JSON prediction file: this is a one-arm soak, not an A/B.

The site map and this reading are posted on #372.

Still owed once #381 merges: the soak (perflog build, Thor, 240 s, reading 135-265 s, rerun if the guest exits early), the per-site counters posted on #372, and the priced patch (or a statement that no small hunk exists). That work needs a new PR from this branch. If #381 is already merged when the next session resumes, it should queue the soak straight away.

`gh pr edit` failed again, so I updated the PR body through the REST API and checked it read back correctly.

The Claude Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorising in your claude.ai connector settings before they can be used. This task didn't need them.
